mainEntity.name: Is PTIN mandatory for property registration in Hyderabad?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, within CURE limits. From November 2026, a PTIN or VLTIN must be entered to book a registration slot.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between PTIN and VLTIN?

acceptedAnswer.text: A PTIN is for buildings that pay property tax. A VLTIN is for open land that pays Vacant Land Tax.

mainEntity.name: My property has no PTIN. Can I still register it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Only after you get a PTIN or VLTIN and pay the tax. In urgent cases, registration can go ahead as pending, but the document is released only after the tax is paid.

mainEntity.name: How do I get a new PTIN?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apply for self-assessment on the GHMC, Cyberabad or Malkajgiri corporation website or the My CURE App. The corporation verifies the property and issues the number.

mainEntity.name: What about flats bought before the OC?

acceptedAnswer.text: This is not yet clear. Flats are usually assessed only after the OC, so ask your builder and sub-registrar how such sales will be registered.
The memorandum covers CURE limits only, as reported.
